newsitem.title: CANADA: Power Financial ups dividend, sees growth.
newsitem.headline: Power Financial ups dividend, sees growth.

text.p: Canada's Power Financial Corp increased its quarterly dividend on Thursday and said it was poised for more growth in the United States and Europe.
The holding company controlled by Montreal's wealthy Desmarais family said it increased its quarterly dividend to 22.5 Canadian cents from 20.5 cents.

Power Financial also said that first-quarter earnings rose to C$112.3 million, or C63 cents a share, from year earlier C$77.7 million or C43 cents a share. The latest first-quarter earnings were boosted by a C$24.4 million gain on the sale of long-term holdings held through Parjointco N.V.
Quarterly revenues fell to C$1.55 billion from C$1.58 billion.

After Power Financial's annual meeting, Chairman Paul Desmarais Jr said the company expected its holdings in North America and Europe to grow in coming years, but was not planning any major acquisitions at the moment.

In the United States, Power Financial's Colorado-based Great-West Life & Annuity Insurance Co is focusing on expanding One Health Plan, its Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) to all 25 states in which it operates.

In Europe, Power Financial is focusing on four key strategic investments -- construction and industrial minerals and metals company Imetal S.A., RTL, which is Europe's biggest audiovisual group, Petrofina S.A., an oil, gas and petrochemical concern, and Suez, which builds public services and infrastructure projects.
